finding: Duplicate topography records duplicate site 19 in spatial analyses and the all-sample climate model.
evidence: lifeonair/results/inputs/topography.tsv has two site-19 rows; actual bulk/surface/root site counts are 51/45/59, versus output 52/46/60; unique-site bulk 1l ERA5 rho=-0.400951 versus saved -0.372624; nine primary samples belong to site 19.
requested_action: Resolve the two records using provenance, enforce unique join keys and regenerate spatial models, bootstrap blocks, sensitivities, figures and corrections.

finding: Still open from R1-13: Surface precipitation associations are falsely described as robust across every product and sensitivity analysis.
evidence: H3_spatial_by_marker_position.tsv: surface 1l POWER rho=-0.317, q=0.0546, six-block CI -0.67 to 0.12; blended rho=-0.207, q=0.253; all four blended-product surface correlations are nonsignificant; ERA5 surface 1l composition-adjusted rho=-0.198, p=0.192.
requested_action: After correcting joins, distinguish ERA5-specific support from cross-product sensitivity and revise the abstract, Discussion and figure interpretation.

finding: Still open from R1-20: Cluster holdout retains external homologues and does not implement the claimed all-proteins-above-50%-identity exclusion.
evidence: Only EQ markers are clustered and held out; HydDB/Cordero references remain; recorded HydDB identities are >=50% for 445/445 retained 1h, 138/138 2a and 997/1111 1l proteins.
requested_action: Rename the existing benchmark accurately; include external references in a verified disjoint holdout if claiming sequence-distance generalisation; separate label recovery from functional validation.

finding: Still open from R1-20: Substantial form-I CoxL cross-assignment is not incorporated into the biological conclusions.
evidence: At clu50/60%, 14594 true-form-I fragments, 4285 other-CoxL fragments and 24 non-marker fragments are assigned form I; precision=0.7720; bulk other-CoxL GE=2.28989 versus form-I GE=0.10546.
requested_action: Test whether CoxL contrasts survive a more specific classifier or bounded classification-error analysis; report lineage-dependent performance and avoid blanket specificity claims.

finding: Still open from R1-20: The new benchmark does not validate copies-per-genome calibration or lineage-dependent SCG normalisation.
evidence: The benchmark tests marker fragment assignments while retaining the SCG reference set; it does not reconstruct GE from mixtures with known genome abundance and marker dosage.
requested_action: Benchmark the complete GE estimator on known-composition communities, including SCG detection and lineage-dependent sensitivity; qualify GE as an estimated marker-to-SCG measure.

finding: Still open from R1-01: Corrected assignments and retained-contig restrictions are not consistently propagated; the R1-19 reconciliation also remains incomplete.
evidence: atmo_classification_v2.tsv retains 1619 form_I|AYRGAGR(formI) entries; operon_summary_v2.tsv counts 1124 group-1l loci versus 1111 retained typed proteins; marker_context.tsv includes 13 removed-contig 1l loci.
requested_action: Produce one consistent versioned annotation table, update affinity flags and retained-locus neighbourhood summaries, and document community-reference sequences separately from representative carriage.

finding: Motif absence is incorrectly equated with a missing motif region.
evidence: coxL_class_v2.tsv includes motif-less form-I calls GNJLGD_01456, length 790, identity 55.1%, coverage 99.1%; GLDPPN_00156, length 810, identity 68.8%, coverage 98.6%.
requested_action: Inspect aligned catalytic regions, distinguish truncation from motif divergence, and report a sensitivity excluding unresolved functional calls.

finding: Still open from R1-23: Available expedition-4 controls are omitted, and the rebuttal incorrectly says blanks exist only for expedition 5.
evidence: Companion data-paper/paper/02_methods.tex:110 documents six expedition-4 extraction blanks linked to 97 biological profiles; REPO/manuscript/main.tex:587 documents a shotgun negative control.
requested_action: Incorporate available assay-appropriate controls, document batch coverage and gaps, and correct the response and Methods.

finding: Still open from R1-23: The new batch-frequency flags are not used in the reported contamination sensitivity.
evidence: All five IDs in decontam/flagged_reps_by_batch.txt are absent from reads/excl_v2_noflagged.txt; no downstream code consumes the new flag list.
requested_action: Recompute sensitivity using the documented union of applicable flags and propagate it into relevant read-based and MAG-based analyses.

finding: Still open from R1-22: Genus regression lacks site-propagated uncertainty and adequate handling of prevalence and incomplete-genome non-detection.
evidence: Revised table has 289 genera, 121 zero responses and 32 single-representative genera; nonzero filtering selects on the response; bootstrap at lines 110–121 concerns a different model; independent order-fixed diagnostic retains beta=-1.035, SE=0.221.
requested_action: Bootstrap sites through genus-response construction and fitting, use prevalence-based sensitivity, assess completeness-aware carriage and finer taxonomic control, and retain associative wording.

finding: Community growth estimates can represent only a small fraction of mapped abundance, without a coverage sensitivity.
evidence: In the primary cohort 26 samples have predicted-growth coverage below 80%; 55Sr3=1.45%, 55Dr2=2.30%, 55PRr3=3.10%; estimates are renormalised over genomes with predictions.
requested_action: Report coverage by sample, position and visit; repeat growth-shift models under coverage restrictions and missing-trait bounds, including uncertainty in predicted traits.

finding: Aridity decomposition omits zero-abundance genus/visit combinations before averaging.
evidence: Recomputed site genus-weight sums have mean 1.209 and maximum 2.339; zero-filling restores sums of one and changes observed/turnover-only MAP rho from -0.380/-0.367 to -0.430/-0.433.
requested_action: Zero-fill the appropriate genus-by-visit grid before averaging, verify compositional closure, and regenerate decomposition and mixed-genus outputs.

finding: Still open from R1-07: DNA-adjustment attenuation is interpreted as biological explanation, and differential guild responses are used to discount compositional expansion.
evidence: The root coefficient changes from -2.1198 to -1.3613, a 35.8% statistical attenuation; extract concentration includes plant DNA and extraction effects; no biomass mediation model is fitted.
requested_action: Describe conditional attenuation rather than a fraction explained by biomass; remove the claim that unequal guild responses exclude compositional expansion.

finding: Still open from R1-12: DNA sensitivity models do not consistently retain relevant adjustment and dependence structure.
evidence: The single-kit-visits model omits dna_kit across visits; the bulk-only model at line 171 and bulk DNA/aridity models at lines 206–207 omit visit random effects despite replicated visits.
requested_action: Retain kit adjustment where identifiable and account for site-visit clustering; distinguish within-visit estimates from pooled estimates and report diagnostics.

finding: Still open from R1-14: Temporal precipitation exposure lacks an independent matched-period validation.
evidence: NASA POWER enters climatology only; P365_bestmatch ends in expedition 4 with 71 bulk visits versus 103 for ERA5; no independent five-expedition P90 comparison is implemented.
requested_action: Compare products on identical visits and windows, assess an independent suitable rainfall/moisture source, and qualify the new surface/root rainfall associations accordingly.

finding: The temporal site bootstrap does not assess shared climate-grid uncertainty, residual spatial dependence or expedition leverage.
evidence: ERA5 has 41 distinct daily series across 60 sites; 14/35 repeated bulk sites have two visits and only four have five; bootstrap resamples individual sites conditional on expedition; leave-expedition-out results and bootstrap diagnostics are absent.
requested_action: Assess spatial/grid-aware uncertainty and leave-expedition-out stability; report identifiable exposure variation, convergence and conditional scope of inference.

finding: Temporal equivalence is asserted on a pseudocount-transformed scale without establishing equivalence for the biological quantity.
evidence: Models use log2(GE+0.01); group-2a GE is <=0.01 in 176/546 samples; equivalence bounds use the pooled within-site log-exposure IQR and no temporal pseudocount sensitivity is supplied.
requested_action: Justify the ecological bound, state the transformed estimand and exposure scale, and repeat equivalence assessments under alternative pseudocount/detection treatments.

finding: Still open from R1-15: Within-site unrestricted sample permutations do not preserve site-visit replication.
evidence: how(blocks=site) permits individual samples to exchange across visits and positions; 60 position/visit cells contain two samples and 38 contain three; dispersion permutations remain unrestricted.
requested_action: Use whole-visit exchangeability with suitable position handling or an appropriately aggregated analysis; apply a compatible dispersion test.

finding: The root decomposition mislabels its within-genus term and overstates an accounting partition as a mechanism.
evidence: -0.0046469 is sum(mean genus abundance × change in carrier fraction), not an average carrier-fraction change; missing-side fractions are copied from the observed side; turnover ratio=0.97447, independent site-bootstrap CI approximately 0.967–0.983.
requested_action: Label the weighted community-share contribution correctly, report uncertainty and absence conventions, and qualify turnover attribution as conditional on the recovered catalogue.

finding: The described binomial mixed-genus model is actually a weighted Gaussian model of clipped logits.
evidence: Code fits lmer(qlogis(pmin(pmax(q,0.005),0.995))) with sqrt(w) weights; there is no binomial likelihood or count denominator.
requested_action: Describe the actual likelihood, clipping, weights and interpretation; assess clipping sensitivity if retaining the biological slope claim.

finding: CBB co-carriage is a three-KO screen rather than validated cycle capacity.
evidence: The rule requires K01601, K01602 and K00855; 101/558 1l-only and 30/371 1h-only genomes pass; no sequence-form, catalytic or pathway validation is supplied; incomplete MAGs are treated as negative.
requested_action: Label candidate gene co-occurrence explicitly; validate pathway interpretation and assess high-completeness or missing-gene sensitivity before making capacity comparisons.

finding: Still open from R1-18: Multiplicity families are incompletely specified and do not clearly cover new secondary analyses.
evidence: BH is applied separately within each position contrast and each precipitation exposure/product; genus, NDVI and CBB tests are outside those adjustments, while CBB p=0.020 is highlighted as significant.
requested_action: Declare exact family membership and sizes, identify exploratory unadjusted analyses, and report the complete relevant results with consistent uncertainty and correction.

finding: Still open from R1-17: Failure to detect excess change is presented as established equality with controls.
evidence: Root excess intervals are 1h -0.217 to 0.137, 2a -0.197 to 0.251 and form I -0.193 to 0.143; no equivalence criterion is applied; raw form-I root contrast=-0.360, q=0.0427.
requested_action: Use no detectable additional change relative to controls, or supply a justified equivalence analysis; distinguish raw depletion from excess depletion.

finding: The revised trait and carbon interpretation omits directly relevant literature supplied or identified for this round.
evidence: Wang 2025, DOI 10.1111/gcb.70498, publisher abstract describes 374 MAGs, genomic traits and trace-gas strategies along aridity; local Baril 2023 XML concerns group-1h responses; Kropp 2026 XML concerns glycerol-specific Huc/group-2a regulation.
requested_action: Obtain Wang's full text for a focused comparison and incorporate the verified substrate/group-specific carbon evidence; do not rely on the digest's simplified relevance notes.

finding: Still open from R1-27: The public P3 reproduction route and automated claim verification remain unavailable.
evidence: Availability text acknowledges institutional fetching and an archive TODO; code lacks a complete upstream typing/input-generation entry point; P3 claims remain unregistered; h1_mechanism_v2.R bootstraps without setting a seed.
requested_action: Deposit required inputs and sequences publicly, provide all derivation scripts and pinned dependencies, set deterministic seeds, and add an end-to-end P3 claim-checking workflow.

finding: Still open from R1-30: Final-size typography and tree interpretability remain inadequate, and Figure 2c mixes cohorts and estimands without sufficient labelling.
evidence: PDF scan finds approximately 4.1-pt Figure-1 labels; tree plots suppress tip labels and support; Figure 2c combines 106-visit summaries, a 214-sample DNA model and a growth-shift intercept.
requested_action: Increase typography at final size, annotate diagnostic reference clades/support, and label each effect row with cohort, estimand and interval method.

finding: Still open from R1-32: Several statements disagree with outputs; the R1-33 growth-language correction is also incomplete.
evidence: DNA control slopes are -0.03375 (SE 0.00870) and -0.03187 (SE 0.01240), not absent; copies/carrier contrast=-0.18545 across 105 visits; surface CoxL Moran p=0.0482; text still says communities were faster-growing.
requested_action: Report smaller control associations, correct dosage precision and cohort size, qualify the Moran statement, and consistently say predicted growth potential.

finding: The surface temperature association is insufficiently described and interpreted as evidence for an exposure mechanism.
evidence: Expedition explains 95.84% of T_d30 variance among the 68 contrasts; overall SD=6.30 degrees versus residual SD=1.28; the positive 1h excess slope indicates weaker depletion at higher temperature.
requested_action: Document the exposure model and source, report residual support and leverage sensitivity, and state the direction and observational limits of the result.
